rules: ftd_daily: one record per game and source date; official FTD-rate denominator not found, so two candidates are given (ALL.ftd_rate needs_approval).
cohorts: install-day cohorts; D1/D7/D30 = users active on cohort_date + N / cohort_size. Immature (day after activity_through) = null with reason, never 0.
Domino: no approved DAU, so ftd_rate_over_dau is null and retention counts any row as activity (needs_approval).

DICE.new_user_rule.definition: New user on date_dim = install_date equals date_dim (fact_user_installation.installation_date). Returning = install_date before date_dim.

source_texts.install_date:
Date when user installed the app.
Granularity: per user
Source: fact_user_installation.installation_date
source_texts.date_dim:
Date of the activity record.
Granularity: daily
Source: user_daily_metrics_all_users.date_dim

DICE.new_user_rule.question: install_date and date_dim timezones are both undocumented (DICE.date_timezone); is install_date = date_dim the official "new user"? Rows with install_date later than date_dim or NULL fall in returning.

DOM.new_user_rule.definition: New user on date_dim = install_today_flag ("Whether user installed the app today"), special users excluded, deactivated/fake_invited users INCLUDED.

source_texts.install_today_flag: Whether user installed the app today. Source: int_user_profile.

DOM.new_user_rule.question: The flag is documented, but the population is not: prod_50_reporting.domino_daily_kpis.installs excludes deactivated users (~4.5K new installs/day, e.g. 2026-10-14: 20,684 flagged vs 16,202 reporting installs; see tools/source_metadata/domino_reporting_reconciliation.json). Exclude deactivated/fake_invited like the reporting table? Tied to OI-METRIC-DAU.

DIS.new_user_rule.definition: New user on date_dim = DATE(first_install_ts) equals date_dim (UTC). first_install_ts = the user's first game session, a current-state value.

source_texts.first_install_ts:
Install timestamp: the user's first game session. Current-state value joined on user_id only, so it reflects the profile when the partition was last written. NULL when the user has no session.
Granularity: per user (same on every row of the user)
Calculation: MIN(int_session.start_ts), earliest value kept (in dim_user_profile)
Source: dim_user_profile.first_install_ts
source_texts.date_dim:
UTC calendar date of the user-day: a day with qualifying activity or a valid purchase. Partition column.
Granularity: per user-day
Source: int_user_daily_activity.date_dim, int_user_daily_purchase.date_dim (row spine)

DIS.new_user_rule.question: Source defines install as the first game session, but no "new user" rule is stated; first_install_ts is current-state (re-written per partition). Approve DATE(first_install_ts) = date_dim? Users with NULL first_install_ts are in neither group (unknown_new_flag_rows).

DICE.ftd_users.definition: Users whose first transaction (ftd_ts) falls on date_dim.

source_texts.ftd_ts:
Timestamp of user's first transaction.
Granularity: per user
Source: dim_user_first_purchases.first_td
source_texts.date_dim:
Date of the activity record.
Granularity: daily
Source: user_daily_metrics_all_users.date_dim

DICE.ftd_users.question: ftd_ts is a timestamp; date_dim timezone undocumented. Is DATE(ftd_ts) (UTC) = date_dim the FTD day?

DOM.ftd_users.definition: Users with ftd_today_flag ("Whether today is the user's first transaction date").

source_texts.ftd_today_flag: Whether today is the user's first transaction date. Source: int_user_daily_purchase.

DIS.ftd_users.definition: Users whose first valid purchase (first_purchase_ts, current-state) is on date_dim and who purchased that day.

source_texts.first_purchase_ts:
Timestamp of the user's first valid purchase. Current-state value joined on user_id only, so it can be later than date_dim and reflects the profile when the partition was last written. NULL for users who never purchased.
Granularity: per user (same on every row of the user)
Calculation: MIN(purchased_ts) over valid int_purchase rows, earliest value kept (in dim_user_profile)
Source: dim_user_profile.first_purchase_ts
source_texts.trx_cnt:
Number of valid purchases on the user-day; 0 on rows without a purchase.
Granularity: per user-day
Calculation: COALESCE(trx_cnt, 0); upstream COUNT(*) over the day's valid int_purchase rows
Source: int_user_daily_purchase.trx_cnt
source_texts.date_dim:
UTC calendar date of the user-day: a day with qualifying activity or a valid purchase. Partition column.
Granularity: per user-day
Source: int_user_daily_activity.date_dim, int_user_daily_purchase.date_dim (row spine)

DIS.ftd_users.question: No FTD column; derived from first_purchase_ts (current-state). Approve?

ALL.ftd_rate.definition: Official FTD-rate denominator not found in any source read (table/column descriptions; Confluence not accessible). Two candidates are published: ftd_users / DAU and ftd_users / new users (same day).
ALL.ftd_rate.question: Which denominator is official: DAU or same-day new users (or something else)? Note FTD users are not only new users.

DICE.retention.definition: Install-day cohort = users with install_date = date_dim and sessions_cnt > 0 that day. Retained on DN = sessions_cnt > 0 on cohort_date + N.

source_texts.install_date:
Date when user installed the app.
Granularity: per user
Source: fact_user_installation.installation_date
source_texts.sessions_cnt:
Number of sessions on this date.
Granularity: per user-day
Calculation: COUNT(session_id)
Source: user_daily_activity.cnt_sessions
source_texts.date_dim:
Date of the activity record.
Granularity: daily
Source: user_daily_metrics_all_users.date_dim

DICE.retention.question: Official retention definition (activity = session? cohort timezone?) not found.

DOM.retention.definition: Install-day cohort = users with install_today_flag on date_dim. Retained on DN = any row on cohort_date + N (no approved DAU definition, DOM.active_users_dau).

source_texts.install_today_flag: Whether user installed the app today. Source: int_user_profile.

DOM.retention.question: Depends on the Domino DAU definition (OI-METRIC-DAU); a row is not proven activity. The reporting table domino_daily_kpis has retention_d1/d7/d30_users_count keyed by install date: D1 is within ~0.5% of ours (it excludes deactivated users), D7 differs by up to +13% (its day-7 rule is not documented), and immature days are written as 0 there. Which one is official?

DIS.retention.definition: Install-day cohort = users with DATE(first_install_ts) = date_dim and is_active_day. Retained on DN = is_active_day on cohort_date + N.

source_texts.first_install_ts:
Install timestamp: the user's first game session. Current-state value joined on user_id only, so it reflects the profile when the partition was last written. NULL when the user has no session.
Granularity: per user (same on every row of the user)
Calculation: MIN(int_session.start_ts), earliest value kept (in dim_user_profile)
Source: dim_user_profile.first_install_ts
source_texts.is_active_day:
TRUE when the user has qualifying activity on the day (at least one activity-stream event other than identify_as_event and app_gain_focus); FALSE on purchase-only rows. Never NULL. Use COUNTIF(is_active_day) for DAU.
Granularity: per user-day
Calculation: an int_user_daily_activity row exists for (user_id, date_dim)
Source: int_user_daily_activity
source_texts.date_dim:
UTC calendar date of the user-day: a day with qualifying activity or a valid purchase. Partition column.
Granularity: per user-day
Source: int_user_daily_activity.date_dim, int_user_daily_purchase.date_dim (row spine)

DIS.retention.question: Official retention definition not found; cohort uses current-state first_install_ts.

DICE.active_users_dau.definition: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) WHERE sessions_cnt > 0 (users_with_any_row also exported)

source_texts.dice-dreams-dbt.40_mart.user_daily_metri:
Number of sessions on this date.
Granularity: per user-day
Calculation: COUNT(session_id)
Source: user_daily_activity.cnt_sessions

DICE.active_users_dau.question: No DAU column or DAU rule is defined in this table. Is DAU = users with sessions_cnt > 0, or every user-day row (rows may include purchase-only days)?

DOM.active_users_dau.definition: NOT EXPORTED (null) - proposed (needs approval): COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) WHERE NOT special_user_flag AND NOT deactivated_user_flag AND NOT fake_invited_user_flag

source_texts.domino-dreams-dbt.prod_40_mart.user_dail: Whether user was active today (PAU - periodic active user). Source: int_user_daily_activity.
Number of sessions for the day. Source: int_user_daily_activity.
Whether user account is deactivated. Source: int_user_profile.
Whether user is a fake invited user. Grain: user. Source: int_user_profile.
source_texts.headquarters-dbt.50_reporting.rpt_superp: dau. Granularity: date_dim, studio. Source: Aggregated from mrt_daily_agg_dice.dau
Paying active users. Granularity: date_dim, studio. Calculation: IFNULL(SUM(pau), 0). Source: mrt_daily_agg_dice, mrt_daily_agg_domino, and mrt_daily_agg_solitaire
source_texts.headquarters-dbt.40_mart.mrt_daily_agg_d: dau. Granularity: date_dim, platform, country_code, media_source. Source: Aggregated from stg_udm_base_domino_vw.dau

Paying active users with positive lifetime purchase value. Granularity: date_dim, platform, country_code, media_source. Calculation: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) where purchase_ltv > 0. Source: stg_udm_base_domino_vw.user_id, stg_udm_base_domino_vw.purchase_ltv
source_texts.headquarters-dbt.30_intermediate.int_val: DAU. Granularity: date_dim. Calculation: COUNT DISTINCT user_id after flag filters. Source: domino_dbt_mart.user_daily_metrics.user_id

Domino UDM aggregated by date: dau, gross_revenue, net_revenues, ad_revenues, paying_users. Live cutover via domino_dbt_mart.user_daily_metrics (DF user_daily_metrics), with deactivated/special/fake_invited filters. Gross = inapp + stripe; net = inapp_net + stripe_net. Grain: date_dim. Window: last 120 days through yesterday.
source_texts.domino-dreams-dbt.prod_50_reporting.domi: Daily active users count. Source: user_daily_metrics.
Payer active users count. Source: user_daily_metrics.

DOM.active_users_dau.question: Approve Domino DAU = distinct users per date_dim in prod_40_mart.user_daily_metrics excluding special, deactivated and fake_invited users (the filter documented in HQ int_val_udm_day_agg_domino_vw; matches Domino prod_50_reporting.domino_daily_kpis.dau on 29.10, 30.10, 1.11 and within 1 user on 31.10). Note: this uses more exclusions than the other Domino metrics (special only; see DOM.exclusions). | HQ rpt_superplay_agg.dau for Domino comes from mrt_daily_agg_domino.dau, "Aggregated from stg_udm_base_domino_vw.dau"; that staging view was not readable (10_staging blocked; HQ queries 403). Confirm the proposed value equals HQ "Superplay Daily agg" Domino DAU for 29.10-1.11.

Calculation: an int_user_daily_activity row exists for (user_id, date_dim)

Granularity: one row per user_id, date_dim (UTC) on days with qualifying activity (`int_user_daily_activity`) or at least one valid purchase (`int_user_daily_purchase`). Purchase-only days have is_active_day = FALSE, so count DAU with COUNTIF(is_active_day), not COUNT(*). Partitioned by date_dim, clustered by user_id.
